title: David Sacks - How to Operate a SaaS Startup - [Invest Like the Best, EP. 234]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: My guest today is David Sacks, General Partner at Craft Ventures and founding COO of PayPal.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is David Sacks, General Partner at Craft Ventures and founding COO of PayPal. During our conversation, we explore what differentiates Enterprise SaaS from DTC subscriptions, what makes for a magical product launch event. David has written extensively on his idea of operating cadence, and we explore how that applies to the various functions within an organization.

key_points.text: During our conversation, we explore what differentiates Enterprise SaaS from DTC subscriptions, what makes for a magical product launch event.
As time goes on, I am more and more impressed at the talent that existed within the original PayPal mafia.
This was an incredibly informative conversation with fun threads throughout.
